newsitem.title: UK: Eurolire options set daily volume record -LIFFE.
newsitem.headline: Eurolire options set daily volume record -LIFFE.

text.p: Trade in LIFFE Eurolire options set a daily record on Monday, with some 26,000 contracts trading against a previous record of around 23,000, a LIFFE official told Reuters.
Precise figures were not immediately available, the official said.
"It's difficult to know the exact reason behind the record volume," he said.
"But obviously there is a great deal of uncertainty attached to EMU (European Economic and Monetary Union) qualification for Italy and the general economic situation there."
